arb.text: Eleni, a girl of the Knotvine tribe stranded in Jund, hides in a dim cave when a wurm thunders overhead, and asks the stranger she takes for a wizard to save them.
She scrambles down a tunnel to find mana, but the undead wurm plunges through the ceiling and separates them, and it later bursts up through the lava and traps the narrator on a ledge.
Eleni refuses to abandon him, and when he tells her to use the relic of Progenitus she shouts a command word that disintegrates the wurm.
She then finds food and shelter and negotiates with a human warrior-clan, becoming one of them.
